name: wa2agent
description: A hosted, read-only WhatsApp MCP server for the chats you choose. It cannot send messages.

description_i18n.en: A hosted, read-only WhatsApp MCP server for the chats you choose. It cannot send messages.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 托管的只读 WhatsApp MCP 服务，用于读取你选择的聊天，无法发送消息。

WA_VAULT_URL.title: Vault MCP URL
WA_VAULT_URL.description: Your vault URL from Connect your agent at https://wa2agent.link: https://vault-<id>.wa2agent.link/mcp.

WA_VAULT_TOKEN.title: Access key (WA_VAULT_TOKEN)
WA_VAULT_TOKEN.description: The access key from your vault, without the Bearer prefix. This is separate from the encryption key note.
